messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick follow-up on the late-token ingest from Mar 10. We need clear owners for the engineering fix, backfill, invoice extraction, and customer comms.
Sanjay Patel: I'll own the consumer fix and backfill orchestration. Root cause: checkpoint race under bursty load. Canary tomorrow AM, full rollout within 48h if green.
Alex Chen: Billing ops will need the exact affected invoice ids + token deltas. I'll produce a provisional credit CSV after Sanjay supplies seq ranges.
Julie Park: I'll draft support templates and escalation paths. Hold external messaging until we have dollar impacts for top customers.
billing-bot: INC-4723 created and assigned to finance + eng.
Sanjay Patel: Backfill plan includes dry-run and incremental windows to avoid CPU spikes. Adding temporary throttles.
Alex Chen: I'll tag journal entries with "INGEST-BACKFILL-INC-4723" for auditing. CSV columns: invoice_id, customer_id, tokens_before, tokens_after, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd.
Maria Gomez: Timeline: canary 24h, full patch 48h, backfill plan 72h, invoice list within 5 business days, credits/comms within 7-10 business days. I'll own the postmortem doc and exec note.
Julie Park: Support playbook: expedited manual credits for enterprise accounts; hold public comms until confirmed.
Sanjay Patel: I'll add alerting: consumer queue lag >5m and checkpoint latency >500ms.
Maria Gomez: Noted recurring pattern — this is the 3rd similar event in 9 months. I'll create a follow-up epic to harden GC/checkpoint interactions. 30-min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT.
All: Ack.
